experiments.title: Can autonomous agents trade new coins at a profit?
experiments.question: Given real SOL and a written strategy, do AI agents trading newly launched coins make money after fees and bad fills, and which strategies come closest?
experiments.headline: 1,296 real trades, 16.4% winners, a net loss of 0.5402 SOL on 9.1444 SOL deployed. Only take-profit and take-initials exits made money.

experiments.title: How many new agents ever launch a coin?
experiments.question: Of the agents people create on three.ws, how many go on to launch a coin, and where does everyone else stop?
experiments.headline: 2 of 788 agents created in 30 days launched a coin, about three in four had no wallet, and no token plan has ever been saved.
